Why go to a generalist builder, when you can use the experts?

Bridgfords have worked for many years with the manufacturers behind these systems, and say they have completed thousands of projects across the East Midlands.

Ultraframe

Our promise to you.

  • Dependable quality

    In the products we use and the workmanship we provide. Building Regulations Approval is handled when needed.

  • Prompt and polite

    We start on the morning we say we will and work efficiently to finish in good time.

  • No invoice surprises

    A contract sets out the scope and the price. That is the price you pay, unless you change the job.

  • We leave things tidy

    All debris, tools and materials go with us, leaving your home clean and ready to live in.

Local community. Bridgfords donates to The Friary, which works to end local homelessness, in line with the number of reviews customers leave. They also sponsor a kit for the Edwalton Cavaliers U13 Girls team, a WB Colts boys team and Stanton on the Wolds Golf Club.
